text: 9月6日，中国人寿集团宣布，财政部将向中国人寿保险（集团）公司注资350亿元，进一步增强中国人寿稳健经营和风险抵御能力，为公司专注主业、完善治理、错位发展注入动力。（新华社）
text_en: On Sept 6, China Life Group announced that the Ministry of Finance will inject 35 billion yuan into China Life Insurance (Group) Company, further enhancing China Life's sound operation and risk resilience, and injecting momentum for the company to focus on its main business, improve governance, and pursue differentiated development. (Xinhua)
